description: Reports whether this request is authenticated and, if so, which Organiq account it uses (name, plan, how it authenticated), how many Search Console properties are available with their data coverage, and what is missing (no account, no properties, and per property GA4, Bing and branded terms) with the panel URL and the steps that resolve each gap. Without credentials it explains how to connect. Use it when a tool returned unauthorized/site_not_found or before a first analysis. / Diz se há conta, propriedades, plano e o que falta, com a URL para resolver.
name: check_connection
title: Connection status
